repository_ledger_location.designation_source: StegVerse-org/.github .stegverse/transition-ledger/org-contract.json organization_ledger_ref (StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#368 issuecomment-6092785329); the same subtree form StegVerse-org/.github declares for its own repository chain and StegVerse-org/StegVerse-SDK declares for the SDK.
repository_ledger_location.initialization: Genesis is a REPOSITORY_LEDGER_INITIALIZATION transition whose first receipt has previous_receipt_sha256 null. Publication of the ref is the organization's own append under ORGANIZATION_LEDGER_LOCK. Not performed by this repository.
repository_ledger_location.rule: The repository chain is kept in its own subtree of the designated organization ledger ref. Repository replay walks repository-ledger/StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter/HEAD.json back through its own receipts and never reads an organization receipt. Existing organization-ledger commits are not rewritten.
repository_ledger_location.expected_genesis_note: Null until the genesis inputs are supplied, not because the digest is unknowable. The REPOSITORY_LEDGER_INITIALIZATION genesis receipt is byte-deterministic at a supplied heartbeat epoch: emit.py takes observed_at from the receipt's own hb_reference (SUPPLIED_HB_EPOCH:<epoch>, StegVerse-Labs/.github#3263), and a genesis without a supplied epoch is refused HB_EPOCH_NOT_SUPPLIED (a clock-derived one HB_EPOCH_INVALID; predicate SUBMISSION_CARRIES_THE_SUPPLIED_HB_EPOCH; StegVerse-Labs/.github#3290). So this field is precomputed by expected_genesis_computation below once the organization's append route supplies the initialization inputs (epoch, predecessor and successor state digests, evidence); after the append, pin-after-observe is only the read-back check that the observed genesis equals it (EXPECTED_GENESIS_PIN_CONFLICT otherwise). No digest is invented here. Until it is set, consumers fail closed ORG_LEDGER_GENESIS_NOT_PINNED (StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#432 org_ledger_location). Dependency: the org kernel's hb_reference keeps a clock fallback until StegVerse-org/.github#196 lands, and the org's precedent genesis for repository-ledger/StegVerse-org/.github carries derived_from_clock true; such a genesis is refused, not pinned.

expected_genesis_computation.receipt_body: emit.py receipt_body: schema stegverse.repo-transition-receipt/v1, repository, transition_id (default REPOSITORY_LEDGER_INITIALIZATION:<repository>), transition_class REPOSITORY_LEDGER_INITIALIZATION, predecessor_state_sha256, successor_state_sha256, evidence, authority_effect, hb_reference, ordering OSCILLATOR_HEARTBEAT_EPOCH_ONLY, observed_at, observed_at_is_descriptive_not_ordering true, previous_receipt_sha256 null
expected_genesis_computation.hb_reference: {epoch, heartbeat_id HB:<epoch>, frequency_hz rate_hz, period_ms, progression_dependency OSCILLATOR_ONLY, derived_from_clock false, authority_effect NONE} from .stegverse/heartbeat-awareness.json
expected_genesis_computation.digest: sha256: + hex sha256 of json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded UTF-8
expected_genesis_computation.supplied_epoch_rule: supplied_epoch_failure (byte copy, SUPPLIED_EPOCH_FAILURE_SHA256 7f36f0e697cadc91acd27af121eee3fc460b887ec67cfa258727bfccec0ca5f8): absent HB_EPOCH_NOT_SUPPLIED; not ASCII [0-9]+, below 32 or derived_from_clock not exactly false HB_EPOCH_INVALID

expected_genesis_open_item.required_evidence_or_repair: The digest is deterministic (expected_genesis_computation: the emit.py receipt body at a supplied epoch, canonical JSON, sha256), but four of its inputs are not yet fixed by anyone entitled to fix them: the supplied hb epoch, predecessor_state_sha256, successor_state_sha256 and evidence of the REPOSITORY_LEDGER_INITIALIZATION append for repository-ledger/StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter. They are fixed by the organization's admitted append route for refs/stegverse/organization-ledger, which is not admitted (MERGE_APPEND_PATH_NOT_ADMITTED; no org-ledger head attester published). Separately, the org kernel's hb_reference keeps a clock fallback until StegVerse-org/.github#196 lands (draft, open, head fd683c63, stacked on #188, which merged 2026-10-20), so an org-emitted genesis can still carry derived_from_clock true and is refused HB_EPOCH_INVALID, not pinned. Repair: once the append route supplies those inputs, run the precompute entrypoint and set this field to its output through the REPOSITORY_LEDGER_GENESIS_PIN transition, never by hand; after the append the read-back must equal it (EXPECTED_GENESIS_PIN_CONFLICT otherwise).
expected_genesis_open_item.retry_entrypoint: scripts/llm_adapter_repository_ledger_genesis_pin.py precompute --hb-epoch <supplied epoch> --predecessor-state-sha256 <sha256> --successor-state-sha256 <sha256> --evidence-json <json>, then scripts/llm_adapter_genesis_pin_ingress.py (REPOSITORY_LEDGER_GENESIS_PIN receiver) on the receipted genesis read-back
expected_genesis_open_item.owning_existing_goal: StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#431 (organization-ledger onboarding; REPOSITORY_LEDGER_GENESIS_PIN), StegVerse-org/.github#162; clock-fallback dependency StegVerse-org/.github#196 (InTr consumers lane)
expected_genesis_open_item.next_attempt: on the admission of the org-ledger append route that supplies the genesis inputs, with StegVerse-org/.github#196 landed (event-triggered)
